VI.description: Shares the front panel of VI in a web browser and returns immediately. Leave VI unwired to share the CALLER (the VI one level up in the call chain\2C opened by name). URL is the link to open\2C with the share's access token\3A every request needs it (docs\5Csecurity.md). By default the share is reachable from this computer only (http\3A//127.0.0.1\3A<port>/?t=...)\3B whole network? TRUE listens on every interface and the URL uses this computer's IP address. token empty makes a new random token (32 hex digits from the operating system's secure random number generator)\3B view only? TRUE ignores the browsers' input. Several shares can run in one LabVIEW application instance\2C each on its own port (the Server Loop is reentrant)\3A a port that is already shared here returns error 5001 and launches nothing. Otherwise (RemoteVI Launch Share.vi) Start opens a new clone of ..\5CServer\5CRemoteVI Server Loop.vi (RemoteVI Open Server Loop.vi)\2C sets its controls and runs it without waiting (RemoteVI Launch Server Loop.vi)\2C and waits until the loop has created its TCP listener\3A the loop sends the listener's error cluster on the notifier RemoteVI\3A<port>\3Astarted\2C and Start returns that error (e.g. 60 when the port is in use - the loop has then already ended)\2C or 5002 when nothing arrives within 2 s. So error out is clean only when the panel is being served. The share stops on RemoteVI Stop.vi with the same port\2C or by itself once VI is no longer running. RemoteVI Status.vi tells what is shared.

FreeLabel.comment: Token\2C address\2C link\3B then launch a server loop clone

Control.description: The VI to share. Unwired (not a valid refnum)\3A the VI that calls RemoteVI Start.vi.
Most frames per second sent to a client.
FALSE (default)\3A reachable from this computer only (listens on 127.0.0.1). TRUE\3A listens on every interface - reachable by everyone who can reach this computer and has the link.
The access token the link carries. Empty (default)\3A a new random token.
TRUE\3A the browsers see the panel but cannot operate it.
Standard error in. Nothing is started on an incoming error.

CaseFrame.label: Unwired\3A open the caller by name

Indicator.description: The share's link with its access token\3A http\3A//127.0.0.1\3A<port>/?t=<token>\2C or with this computer's IP address when whole network? is TRUE. Give it only to who should operate the panel. (The computer's name is not looked up\3A reverse DNS took 5 s on a test machine.)

Errors opening the caller or the Server Loop\2C making the token (5003)\2C setting the Server Loop's controls or running it\3B 5001 when this port is already shared in this LabVIEW application instance\3B the listener error of the Server Loop (e.g. 60 when the port is in use)\3B 5002 when the Server Loop did not report a listener within 2 s.
